scenes.text: Every night at 3:12, my bedroom wall rises, then falls.
scenes.art_prompt: a dim bedroom at night, one wall lit faintly by a streetlamp, anime-horror

scenes.text: Just a few centimetres. Slow. Like something behind it is breathing.
scenes.art_prompt: a close view of a wall with faint hairline cracks, cold light, anime-horror

scenes.text: I measured it with tape. The wall is now two fingers closer than last month.
scenes.art_prompt: a measuring tape pressed to a wall, pencil marks, dim room, anime-horror

scenes.text: The landlord said the building has no room behind that wall.
scenes.art_prompt: an old building floor plan on a desk under a lamp, one wall circled, anime-horror

scenes.text:
It is not moving toward me.
The whole room is shrinking, and it has been for years.
scenes.art_prompt: a small room with walls visibly leaning inward, one lamp, unsettling, anime-horror

scenes.text: Follow Quiet Horror Files for more.
scenes.art_prompt: a closed bedroom door at the end of a dark hallway, final wide shot, anime-horror
